title: Cookie Policy
description: How {{COMPANY_NAME}} uses cookies and similar technologies.
body:
This page explains how {{SITE_URL}} uses cookies and similar technologies.

## 1. What are cookies?

Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies, such as your browser's local storage, work in a similar way.

## 2. What we use

We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

We store a few small settings in your browser, such as display preferences, so the site works properly. These are essential and do not identify you.

If you book a consultation, our booking provider (Cal.com) may set cookies that are needed for booking to work.

## 3. Analytics

We do not currently use analytics. If we add analytics in the future, we will ask for your consent before setting any non-essential cookies, and update this page.

## 4. Managing cookies

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the site from working.

## 5. Contact

If you have questions about this policy, email us at {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}.
